title: Retry charges on 5xx with an idempotency key
body: The payments API returns transient 502s during their deploys. Retry up to 3 times with an Idempotency-Key so a retry never double-charges, and log each failed attempt so we can see it in Datadog.

labels.note: The retry warning logs the full request headers, which include Authorization: Bearer <PAYMENTS_API_KEY>. Every failed attempt writes the live payments key to the logs shipped to Datadog.
